method: Authentic front blade/handle/rivet plate and back blade/handle/ribbon rotate independently around the painted flower rivet. Ribbon tips deform locally; no hidden joint geometry is invented. Source alpha noise <=2/255 removed in derivative only.

actions.idle: Suspended bob, small mechanical jaw play and localized ribbon flutter.
actions.attack: Handles spread in anticipation; blades perform one upward snip away from the visitor, ribbon follows, then the shears recover.
actions.hurt: Sharp jaw recoil and body deflection, short ribbon flutter, recover.
actions.defeat: Blades fold closed; the shears roll and sink gently onto their side, then remain still.

quality_gate: Key poses inspected for coherent joints and identity. Full frame checks and full-speed intended-size review pending.
